reading.title: Bioluminescence in Marine Organisms
reading.passage: Bioluminescence, the production of light by living organisms, is a fascinating phenomenon found predominantly in marine environments. Deep-sea creatures utilize this ability for various purposes including communication, hunting, and defense. The process involves a chemical reaction where luciferin, a light-emitting compound, reacts with oxygen in the presence of the enzyme luciferase. Approximately 90% of deep-sea organisms produce bioluminescence, making it one of nature's most common adaptations in extreme environments. This remarkable feature allows creatures to thrive in complete darkness where sunlight cannot penetrate.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary environment where bioluminescence is found?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '주로 해양 환경에서 발견되는' 현상이라고 명시하고 있습니다. 정답은 B (Marine environments)입니다.

questions.q: Which enzyme is mentioned as essential for bioluminescence?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 루시페린이 산소와 루시퍼라제 효소의 존재 하에 반응한다고 설명합니다. 정답은 B (Luciferase)입니다.

questions.q: What percentage of deep-sea organisms produce bioluminescence?
questions.explanation: 본문의 마지막 문장에서 '심해 생물의 약 90%가 생물발광을 생성한다'고 명시하고 있습니다. 정답은 C (Approximately 90%)입니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Technology has made human relationships less meaningful. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (동의 또는 불동의) + 논문의 주요 논거 미리 제시 (2-3개). 예: '저는 기술이 인간관계를 덜 의미있게 만든다는 주장에 동의하지 않습니다. 오히려 기술은 관계를 유지하고 깊이 있는 소통을 가능하게 합니다.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 논거 개발: 기술이 장거리 관계 유지에 어떻게 도움이 되는지 구체적 예시 제시 (화상통화, SNS를 통한 지속적 연락 등)
structure.body2: 두 번째 논거 개발: 기술이 새로운 관계 형성을 가능하게 하는 방식 설명 (온라인 커뮤니티, 관심사 기반 연결 등) + 구체적 사례
structure.conclusion: 주요 주장 재강조 + 기술 사용의 책임감 있는 방식 언급 + 마무리 문장으로 전체 주제 종합

speaking.prompt: Some people believe that reading books is more beneficial than watching videos. Others think watching videos is a more effective way to learn. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer reading books because
One reason is that reading allows for deeper comprehension
For example, when I read a novel, I can
Furthermore, books provide detailed information that
Another advantage is that reading develops critical thinking skills
On the other hand, videos are useful for visual learners
In conclusion, I believe reading is more beneficial overall
sample_points: 첫 번째 이유: 독서는 개인의 속도에 맞춰 학습할 수 있으며, 복잡한 개념을 깊이 있게 이해할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 과학 교과서를 읽을 때 어려운 부분을 여러 번 반복해서 읽을 수 있습니다.
두 번째 이유: 책은 더 자세한 정보와 다양한 관점을 제공하며, 비판적 사고력 발달에 도움이 됩니다. 또한 독서는 어휘력 증진과 상상력을 자극합니다.

listening.title: University Library Orientation
listening.script: Librarian: Welcome to our university library! I'm glad you're here for the orientation. Let me show you around. This is the main reading area where students can study quietly. We have computers available for research, and over there is our digital collection section. Student: This is impressive! Where would I find academic journals? Librarian: Great question! Academic journals are primarily accessed through our online database. You can search from home using your university login. We also have physical copies of popular journals in this section. Additionally, I recommend visiting our research help desk on the second floor. The librarians there specialize in helping students locate and evaluate sources for their papers. Student: That's really helpful. Do you have any workshops? Librarian: Yes! We offer weekly workshops on citation styles, database searching, and academic writing. You can sign up online on our website. I also suggest attending our beginner's research session next Tuesday at 3 PM. Many students find it invaluable for starting their research projects.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To provide a library orientation for new students
To recruit volunteers for the library
questions.explanation: 대화 전반을 통해 사서가 새로운 학생을 도서관 시설, 자료 접근 방법, 제공되는 서비스에 대해 안내하고 있습니다. 정답은 B (To provide a library orientation for new students)입니다.

questions.q: According to the librarian, how can students primarily access academic journals?
options: Only through physical copies in the library
Through the online database using university login
By visiting the research help desk
questions.explanation: 사서는 '학술 저널은 주로 온라인 데이터베이스를 통해 접근되며, 대학 로그인을 사용하여 집에서도 검색할 수 있다'고 명시했습니다. 정답은 B (Through the online database using university login)입니다.

questions.q: What does the librarian recommend the student do next Tuesday?
options: Visit the research help desk on the second floor
Attend a beginner's research session at 3 PM
questions.explanation: 사서는 학생에게 '다음 주 화요일 오후 3시의 초급자 연구 세션에 참석할 것을 권장한다'고 명시했습니다. 정답은 C (Attend a beginner's research session at 3 PM)입니다.
